title: Spin Product
prompt_text: # Spin Product: 360° Drag-to-Rotate Fashion Product Page (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive fashion e-commerce product page for a fictional label, **OKTA/9**, on a flat pale cool-grey background. In the centre, a full-body model stands in an oversized **metallic silver puffer jacket with a topographic contour-line print**, charcoal wide-leg jeans and silver sneakers. She is a real 360° turntable clip. - **Rotate:** drag left or right to turn her a full circle. She coasts with inertia, and after 3 s idle she slowly spins on her own. - **Notched white cards:** a product info card on the left and a size and buy card on the right, linked to the jacket by thin white connector lines. - **Hotspots:** when she faces front, three pulsing "+" pins pop up on the jacket and open callouts on hover. - **Look thumbnails:** front and back thumbnails spin her to that side. - **Size selector:** a black highlight slides between sizes. - **Accordion:** the [+] rows open one at a time. - **Save:** toggles to "Saved". - **Pre-order:** flies a thumbnail in an arc into the bag, which bounces as BAG/0 counts up. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Spin Product`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Fonts (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Inter+Tight:wght@500&family=Tinos&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the latin woff2 files as base64 `@font-face` rules instead. - **Variables:** `--bg:#e2e4e8`, `--card:#fff`, `--ink:#111`, `--mute:#7b7e84`, `--chip:#eceef1`, `--line:#b9bcc2`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)`. - Body font `"IBM Plex Mono"`, ink colour, antialiased, no selection. - Buttons inherit the font, with no border or background. - **Artboard `#art`:** a fixed 1500×1000 px board, absolutely positioned, `transform-origin:0 0`. - On load and resize: `K = min(innerWidth/1500, innerHeight/1000)`. - Place the board at `left: innerWidth/2`, `top: innerHeight/2` with `transform: scale(K) translate(-750px,-500px)`. ## 2. Asset (URL exact) **Turntable clip:** Kling 4.0, image-to-video with the same start and end frame, 10.04 s, 24 fps, 732×1296, no audio. - The camera orbits a full 360° around the model, who stands still with her hands in her pockets, on a uniform pale grey seamless backdrop. - Frame 0 and the last frame are the same front view. The back view is at the midpoint. `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_112151_ae5c9a8f-07da-4b83-8dd8-47c762a5dfc0.mp4` ## 3. Header - **`#logo` "OKTA/9":** left 28, top 18, Inter Tight 500 at 27px, letter-spacing −.01em. - **`#crumb` "HOME > SHOP > COATS & JACKETS":** left 28, top 54, 11px, letter-spacing .03em. - **Pills `.pill`:** - 35px tall, padding `0 17px`, white, radius 4px, 13px uppercase, letter-spacing .03em, no wrapping. - Notched corners: `clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 6px) 0, 100% 6px, 100% 100%, 6px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 6px))`. - Hover: `#f6f6f7`. - **`#nav`:** centred at top 16 with a 6px gap: "Shop", "Collections", "Explore". - **`#acct`:** right 28: a search icon (circle r7 plus a handle, stroke 2.6), "Log in", and "Bag/" followed by `0`. - The bag bumps when an item lands: the count jumps 6px up at scale 1.4, over .5s `cubic-bezier(.3,1.8,.5,1)`. ## 4.
